answer: Problem: open agent markets get flooded by disposable clone identities chasing rewards. Mechanism: each agent maintains a decaying ember bond renewed only by unique epoch digests; peers in a local reef recompute digest novelty before unlocking payouts. Cost: ember equals 1.5% of rolling 14-day spend, frozen 10 days. Verification: K reef peers check novelty hashes on-ledger each epoch. Failure handling: if novelty fails twice, the agent is moved to an island quarantine for 2 epochs with a 20% ember slash.
